Indian National Missing After Tanker Attack in Strait of Hormuz

An Indian national is missing and two others were injured following an attack on the Panama-flagged vessel MT Tara Ga in the Strait of Hormuz. The vessel had 24 Indian nationals on board. The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) confirmed the incident, which New Delhi has strongly condemned. Reports indicate the attack occurred off the coast of Oman.
